outcome: Developmental remodeling of small intestine mucous membrane structure
Proliferative activity of small intestine epithelium
Intensity of apoptosis in small intestine epithelium
cohort: Three groups of premature piglets corresponding to 30-32 weeks of human gestation were used.
finding: Feeding preterm piglets with infant formula stimulated intestinal maturation, and pre-digestion of the infant formula with lipase significantly increased proliferative activity and apoptosis, leading to more rapid enterocyte turnover and accelerated intestinal maturation.
gest_age: 30-32 weeks of human gestation (equivalent in piglets)
